arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game battle VFX bank: exactly12 chronological hand-drawn transparent RGBA frames, strict4 columns x3 rows. Equal cells, fixed view/origin. Leave a FULL15% transparent moat on all sides INSIDE EACH CELL so no particle crosses gutters or sheet border. Distinct evolving shapes, not repeated icons or one shape resized. High end SSS limited action RPG: razor-sharp negative-space cuts, layered pearl-silver cutting edge, deep ink INDIGO and AMETHYST secondary ribbons, tiny champagne gold steel sparks, crisp refined cinematic rendering. Pure HUMAN sword technique: no holy imagery, halo, crosses, magic runes, summoned swords, angel wings, character, text, labels, numbers, floor tile, UI, grid, checkerboard. No full white screen or opaque smoke. Transparent negative space between cuts, natural tapered ends. SOVEREIGN HORIZON CLEAVE: the battlefield is severed by one immense horizontal plane of sword pressure, deep dark indigo separation between thin white-silver edges. 1-2 tight tiny line gathers,3-4 two long sweeping black-violet crescents fan away from the incision,5-7 a wide razor-bright horizon cut with three large elegant tapering secondary arcs bends air around a transparent center, scattered dark floating debris lit in violet,8-9 the split air peels into broad fine silver-violet ribbons with a few gold sparks,10-12 long beautiful sharp remnants dissolve. Peak should feel like a cinematic awakening finish but be a DRAWN VFX SPRITE, not a finished battle illustration. Entire wide effect silhouette inside each cell. No centered fireball, no large opaque white blast, no ground plume obscuring characters. ABSOLUTELY no opaque or cloudy background, no gray backdrop, no grid line. Background and all unused areas are transparent alpha ZERO, not painted black or gray.
